name: hep-ml-benchmark-A
description: A collection of high-energy physics (HEP) machine-learning benchmark tasks drawn from particle physics problems, intended to evaluate models on classification and regression problems typical in HEP (e.g., event classification, parameter regression). It measures model performance on domain-specific structured and sensor-like data and supports multi-modality inputs common in collider experiments. The benchmark is aimed at assessing how well ML methods generalize to realistic HEP problems and scale to large, imbalanced datasets.
reputation: Niche but respected within the HEP/ML community as a domain-relevant benchmark for particle-physics ML tasks.
